Words: 到了。看来我们的厨师长今晚等得很心急。
Here we are. Looks like our head chef has been waiting out here all night...
他在那儿。大半夜站在风口，神情看起来像惊弓之鸟。
There he is. Standing in the wind at this hour, looking like a spooked bird...
手里空空如也，视线不断往外瞟，绝不是在等我们。
Empty hands, eyes darting toward the street. He's definitely not waiting for us...
当然不是。活儿干完了，他现在是在等主子结账。
Of course not. The job's done. He's out here waiting for his master to settle up.
Brennan 先生……O'Malley 小姐……你们……怎么会在这儿？
Mr. Brennan... Miss O'Malley... what are you... doing here?
晚上好，James。看你满头冷汗的样子，是在等那笔血淋淋的尾款吗？
Good evening, James. Sweating like that in this cold -- waiting for that blood-stained payoff, are you?
我们之间还差一场坦白局。聊聊 Webb 的死，
You and I are overdue for a little heart-to-heart. Let's talk about Webb's death...
聊聊 23:00 到底发生了什么。
Let's talk about what happened at 23:00. Oh, and while we're at it --
还可以聊聊你寄给“鲸鱼”（Whale）先生的信——
we could also discuss that letter you sent to Mr. Whale --
我……我听不懂你们在说什么。厨房太热了，我只是出来透透气……
I... I don't understand what you're talking about. The kitchen was hot... I just came out for some air...
透气？透气需要浑身发抖地躲在暗处吗？
Fresh air? Since when does fresh air require hiding in the dark, shaking like a leaf?
听不懂没关系，等我们把证据一件件摆出来，你的记忆就会恢复的。
Don't worry about understanding. Once we lay out the evidence, piece by piece, your memory will come back just fine.
怎么，不请我们进去慢慢聊吗？
What's the matter -- not going to invite us inside to talk this through?
里面……里面人多嘴杂。就在这儿说吧。你们到底想问什么？
Inside... too many ears inside. Let's just... talk here. What do you want to know?
这么急着撇清关系？
Awfully eager to clear your name, aren't you?...
可要是我说，23:30 根本不是 Webb 真正的死亡时间呢？
But what if I told you... eleven-thirty was never the real time of Webb's death at all?...
怎么不是？！枪声就是 23:30 响的，整个酒吧的人都听见了！
Of course it was! The gunshot was at 23:30 -- everyone in the bar heard it!
如果是其他时间开枪，整栋楼都会听见，根本不可能瞒得过去！
If anyone had fired at a different time, the whole building would've heard it -- there's no way to cover that up!
The gunshot at 23:30?
你是不是把这个借口在心里默念了一百遍，以至于自己都信了？
You've rehearsed that excuse so many times you've started believing it yourself, haven't you?
你说，如果有其他时间的枪响，整栋楼都会听见——确实。
You said if a gun went off at any other time, the whole building would hear it -- and you're right.
除非枪声被更大的动静盖住了。看看这个，你之前在厨房里急着烧毁的东西。
Unless the gunshot was drowned out by something louder. Take a look at this -- the thing you were so desperate to burn in that kitchen.
没烧干净的节目单碎片。上面写着《艾斯弗德狂想曲》和《爵士风暴》，
The half-burned fragments of a program. It lists the Ashford Rhapsody and Jazz Storm --
配器是完整爵士乐队，突出鼓组，音量等级被拉到了最高的 5 级！
full jazz band arrangement, heavy on the drums -- and the volume was cranked to the absolute maximum, level five!
在这种能把屋顶掀翻的强劲鼓点下，别说一声枪响，
Under that kind of roof-shaking drumbeat, forget one gunshot --
就算你在 Webb 的办公室里开十枪，外面也根本听不见一点声响！
you could've emptied ten rounds in Webb's office and no one outside would've heard a single thing!
……那、那又怎样！碎片上连具体时间都被烧掉了，只剩下一个"晚间"！
...So what?! The fragments don't even show the exact time -- all that's left is the word 'evening'!
谁能证明这首曲子到底是什么时候演奏的？
Who can prove when that piece was actually performed?!
还在挣扎？那就再看看这份，Vivian 亲笔签名的节目修改申请。
Still struggling? Then take a look at this -- Vivian's own signed program modification request.
申请上白纸黑字写着，这首 5 级音量的狂暴爵士乐，替换了原本舒缓的抒情曲，
Black and white, right there on the form -- that level-five thunderstorm of jazz replaced the original soft ballad,
演出时间被精准地定在了 23:00 到 23:10！
and the performance was scheduled precisely for 23:00 to 23:10!
这根本不是巧合，而是你精心设计的消音器。
This wasn't coincidence. It was your custom-built silencer.
真正的案发时间是 23:00 到 23:05。
The real time of death -- 23:00 to 23:05.
你借着自己 23:00-23:10 之间惯常的送餐时间，从厨房下来，
You used that 23:00-to-23:10 window -- your usual meal delivery slot -- came down from the kitchen,
杀了 Webb。至于 23:30 的枪声，不过是你为了洗脱嫌疑制造的障眼法！
and killed Webb. As for that gunshot at 23:30 -- it was nothing but a smokescreen you set up to clear your name!
No...
退一万步说，就算是 23:05……
Even if we take a huge step back... even if it was 23:05...
那时连在二楼的我都能听到 Webb 隔着门对Vivian大吼。
At that time, even from the second floor, I could hear Webb shouting at Vivian through the door.
那时Webb还活着！根本不可能是那时候动的手！
Webb was still alive then! There's no way anyone killed him at that hour!
那个声音不是 Webb 的——是你。你的口音，你在厨房就已经露馅儿了。
That voice wasn't Webb's -- it was yours. Your accent gave you away back in the kitchen.
一句在那种情况下，脱口而出的话。
One sentence. Blurted out in the heat of the moment.
“你不要来烦着我！（Don't be bothering me!）”
'Don't be bothering me!'
熟悉吗？James。这句话，
Sound familiar, James? That exact sentence --
你今天在厨房里差点被热锅烫伤时，也一字不差地吼过。
you shouted it word for word in the kitchen today, the moment that hot pan nearly burned you.
巧合！那是 Webb 说的！很多人都会这么说！
Coincidence! That was Webb! Plenty of people say that!
Vivian 听见的就是 Webb 的声音！
Vivian heard Webb's voice! It was Webb!
很多人？你确定吗？看看这份 Anna 的合法移民通过通知。
Plenty of people? You sure about that? Take a look at Anna's legal immigration approval notice.
原籍，爱尔兰科克郡。
Place of origin -- County Cork, Ireland.
附件里还有你的非配额移民资格书。你以为没人去查你的底细吗？
The attachment includes your non-quota immigration eligibility papers. Did you think no one would dig into your background?
你根本不是本地人，你是一个地地道道的爱尔兰非法移民，James。
You're not a local at all. You're a bona fide illegal Irish immigrant, James.
再对比一下你在厨房脱口而出的那句话！
Now compare that with the sentence you blurted out in the kitchen today!
“你不要来烦着我！（Don't be bothering me!）”
'Don't be bothering me!'
这种典型的爱尔兰倒装句法，
That classic Irish inverted construction --
土生土长的美国人 Webb，一辈子也说不出来！
a born-and-bred American like Webb could never have said it in his life!
23:05，Webb 早就成了一具尸体。
At 23:00-oh-five, Webb was already a corpse.
站在门后，隔着门捏着嗓子模仿老板，把 Vivian 骗走的人——就是你！
The one standing behind that door, disguising his voice to send Vivian away -- that was you!
你们……
You...
James，你不是没有动机。你就是因为钱杀了 Webb。
James, you had a motive. You killed Webb for money.
没有。我没缺到那种程度，也没那么急。Webb 会给我的。
No. I wasn't that desperate, and it wasn't that urgent. Webb was going to pay me.
那就看看这份通知。
Then look at this notice.
它不是批准书，是移民局的补件通知。日期和截止期限都写得清清楚楚。
It isn't an approval letter. It's an immigration evidence request, with the date and deadline written plainly.
Anna 必须限期补交费用凭证和经济担保证明。
Anna had to submit fee receipts and proof of financial support by the deadline.
逾期，申请就会被拖延，甚至失效。你说这不急？
Miss the deadline, and the application could be delayed or even lapse. You call that not urgent?
再听听 Anna 亲口说了什么。
Now listen to what Anna told us herself.
孩子快出生了，医院费用和身份文件都在等着钱。
The baby is almost due, and both the hospital costs and identity papers need money.
她说你们家急需一大笔钱。不是以后，是现在。
She said your family urgently needed a large sum. Not later. Now.
这就是你等不起的理由。
That's why you couldn't afford to wait.
是，我是急……可 Webb 会给我的！
Yes, I was pressed... but Webb was going to pay me!
我只是替他做那些脏活。那是 Webb 欠我的钱，
I only did his dirty work. That was money Webb owed me,
不是“鲸鱼”（Whale）给我的钱！
not money from Whale!
我只是没告诉你们我替 Webb 勒索别人！这难道光彩吗？
I just didn't tell you I was extorting people for Webb! Is that something to be proud of?!
可这跟“鲸鱼”（Whale）没有关系。
But that has nothing to do with Whale.
我从来不认识什么“鲸鱼”。
I don't know anyone called Whale.
没见过。那先听听 Tommy 是怎么说的。
Never met him. Then let's hear what Tommy had to say.
在这家酒吧里，除了 Webb 和 Tommy，
In this entire bar, besides Webb and Tommy --
唯一还知道"鲸鱼"（Whale）存在的，
the only other person who even knew Whale existed --
就只有那个贪得无厌的现任勒索者。
was the one greedy enough to take over the extortion.
你对“鲸鱼”（Whale）的事一清二楚——因为你就是那个现任勒索者！
You knew everything about Whale -- because you ARE that current extortionist!
还有这封信。
And then there's this letter.
从你公寓桌角找到的。一封你写给“鲸鱼”（Whale）的回信。
Found on the corner of your desk at home. A reply letter you wrote to Whale.
上面写着：今晚 20:00，后门。你亲手回了他的约。
It says: tonight, 20:00, back door. You answered his summons yourself.
你联系过他。你们之间，不只是听说过名字。
You contacted him. This wasn't just a name you'd heard.
你不是不认识"鲸鱼"（Whale）——
It wasn't that you didn't know Whale --
你已经在等他给你的尾款。
you were already waiting for the balance he owed you.
不……我不是想让所有人都毁掉。
No... I never wanted everyone to be destroyed.
你们不明白。要是，我把他们的事告诉了警察的话……
You do not understand. If I tell the police about them...
等等，Emma。
Wait, Emma.
……什么声音？
...What was that sound?
不……不！他们怎么会提前来？！
No... no! How did they come early?!
你们说得像真的一样。
You make it sound like the truth.
钱、Anna、Vivian……这些名词摆在一起，就能说明什么吗？
Money, Anna, Vivian... you put those words together and that proves something?
如果你们真的了解我做了什么，就别一句一句地吓我！
If you really knew what I did, stop trying to scare me one sentence at a time!
好。那我就从头开始，将你做的事完整地说出来。
All right. Then I will start from the beginning and lay out everything you did.
孩子马上就要出生了，我不能让他们把 Anna 她赶走。
The child is about to be born. I cannot let them drive Anna away.
你为了 Anna 和孩子的安全我可以理解，
I can understand you wanting to keep Anna and the child safe,
但这不代表你应该把别人的命当做代价！
but that does not mean someone else should have to pay with their life!
Webb 死了。Vivian 差点替你上绞架。
Webb is dead. Vivian almost went to the gallows for you.
Rosa 被你逼到崩溃，她女儿也被你拿来威胁。
You drove Rosa to the edge, and you used her daughter to threaten her.
你现在还想装成那个没有选择的人吗？
And now you still want to pretend you had no choice?
他们会先找到 Anna，然后会找到孩子。到那时候，警局保护不了她的。
They will find Anna first, and then they will find the child. When that happens, the police will not be able to protect her.
我可以给你们东西。信、钱、名字……我都能给。
I can give you things. Letters, money, names... I can give you all of it.
求你们，给我一点时间。让我先保证 Anna 的安全……
Please, give me a little time. Let me make sure Anna is safe first...
所以你还要谈条件？到现在还要用这些东西给自己找退路？
So you are still bargaining? Even now, you are using those things to buy yourself a way out?
可以，James，我们先一起把 Anna 转移到安全的地方。
All right, James. First we will move Anna somewhere safe together.
但那之后，你必须和我们一起去警局，向其他人坦白你的罪行。
But after that, you come with us to the station and confess your crimes to everyone.
好的，好的，谢谢您……
Yes, yes. Thank you...
James，冷静！
James, stay calm!
Anna 现在在哪？
Where is Anna now?
离这儿不远。我带你们去。
Not far from here. I'll take you to her.
那就走。现在。
Then let's go. Now.
